author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-Dual-AdaptPC: Auto-τ Whitening + Equal-Quota Graph (k=45, cosine)
abstract: Label-free automatic whitening strength (τ) via participation ratio and anisotropy thresholds, combined with the frozen graph (adaptive residualized PCs, k=45, cosine). Verifies near-SOTA performance without manual τ tuning.
